title: ExternalCustomFieldNoteSearch
description: Search criteria. Every field is optional; an empty body returns every note the caller may see.

closed.description: Omitted: open and closed notes. true: closed only. false: open only.

collabGroupIds.description: Filter by crew. Worklist callers: intersected with the caller's own crews, empty means all of them. API keys: a plain filter, and an empty list matches nothing.

includeIds.description: Only these notes, e.g. a batch fetch after a webhook or a single note for a detail view

query.description: Free text over title, sheet name, creator email and display key

templateIds.description: Notes whose template version belongs to one of these templates

valueFilters.description: Filters on template properties marked x-filterable; requires templateIds or integrationType. A filter is {propertyKey, operator, value} or {propertyKey, or|and: [{operator, value}]}. Operators by property type: strings eq, neq, in, notIn, contains, notContains; enums eq, neq, in, notIn; numbers and dates eq, neq, gte, lte, between (two inclusive bounds); booleans eq, neq; arrays eq, neq, contains, notContains, containsAny, notContainsAny, containsAll, notContainsAll; vendor references also refContains, refNotContains on the referenced record's name; every type isNull, isNotNull. A 400 lists the allowed operators when one does not fit.

zoneIds.description: Notes whose position lies inside one of these zones

CustomFieldNoteValueFilter.description: Filters on template properties marked x-filterable; requires templateIds or integrationType. A filter is {propertyKey, operator, value} or {propertyKey, or|and: [{operator, value}]}. Operators by property type: strings eq, neq, in, notIn, contains, notContains; enums eq, neq, in, notIn; numbers and dates eq, neq, gte, lte, between (two inclusive bounds); booleans eq, neq; arrays eq, neq, contains, notContains, containsAny, notContainsAny, containsAll, notContainsAll; vendor references also refContains, refNotContains on the referenced record's name; every type isNull, isNotNull. A 400 lists the allowed operators when one does not fit.

CustomFieldNoteValueFilterCombinator.description: How valueFilters combine: and (default) or or

ExternalCustomFieldNoteIntegrationType.description: The vendor record type a custom field note mirrors. Null for a site's own templates.

JsonNode.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) with the x-ui-schema, x-external-one-of, x-ui-treatment and x-field-roles extensions. Immutable per version.
